recipes.name: Golden Overnight Couscous
ingredients: ¾ cup canned light coconut milk
instructions: Combine all of the overnight couscous ingredients in a mason jar. Cover and let sit overnight in the fridge.
The next morning, add any desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . † If using oats in place of the couscous, add twice as much. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Store in a mason jar in the fridge for up to 2 days.
